title: Rosalind and the Playlist
author: F. M. Ishikawa
blurb: Paloma Dunmore, the only out kid in a town of nine hundred, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
